g.text: PF-F. Next-day wind speed: W1 versus persistence and climatology (website scorecard cases)
Evidence A: website historical scorecard cases (overall evidence)
Model: deployed W1 (SHA-256 f2db5aa9…9d14b0), historical scoring procedure (_w1_recall_floor.py: pooled scaled_weather inputs, 32-day windows); X1 =
same-date mean of the three stations' scores; warning if X1 ≥ 0.601 (threshold unchanged).
Cases: 3,421 of the 3,423 website cases with raw observed wind on the target and issue days (excluded: target missing 1, issue day missing 1). Truth:
raw, unimputed PAGASA daily wind (m/s; statistic, averaging period and height undocumented). W1 = neural-only output, no MOS or blending.
Baselines: persistence = observed wind of the issue day; climatology = station × month mean, 2015-01-01 to 2020-10-14.
Intervals: paired circular block bootstrap over target dates, 14-day blocks, 2,000 resamples, 95% percentile.
